name: Hands And Feet
overview: Scripture uses hands and feet as powerful symbols of service, strength, and submission to God's will. The consecration of Aaron and his sons with blood on their ears, thumbs, and toes (Exodus 29:20) signifies dedication in hearing, working, and walking in God's commands. The psalms reveal that God empowers the hands for battle and the feet for dominion (Psalms 8:6; 18:34), while also acknowledging the suffering of the Messiah through pierced hands and feet (Psalms 22:16). Believers are called to lift their hands in worship and depend on God to strengthen their hands for faithful labor (Psalms 134:2; Nehemiah 6:9).
